messages.author: fateme haghighi
messages.body:
Hi,
I am installing AMBER24 on GPU of Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS and I faced a problem. I saw AMber24 support CUDA 75-12.5, but my system has CUDA12.6. System does not accept installing another version of CUDA.
How can I solve the problem?
Thank you in advanced

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, Mar 23, 2025, fateme haghighi via AMBER wrote:
>
>I am installing AMBER24 on GPU of Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS and I faced
>a problem. I saw AMber24 support CUDA 75-12.5, but my system has
>CUDA12.6. System does not accept installing another version of CUDA.
Easiest is to edit cmake/CudaConfig.cmake at around line 60, and change the
maximum allowed version from 12.5 to 12.6.
OR: just install an older version of CUDA: no root privliges are required,
and you can set your CUDA_HOME environment variable to the location where
you installed things.
...good luck...dac
